17: db.exec(`
18:   CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
19:     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
20:     title TEXT NOT NULL,
21:     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
22:     created_at TEXT NOT NULL
23:   )
24: `);

29:   id: number;
30:   title: string;

32:   created_at: string;
33: }

35: 
36: // Legacy notification helper — retained for compatibility

39: }
40:

42: function createTask(title: string): Task {
43:   const now = new Date().toISOString();
44:   const stmt = db.prepare(
45:     "INSERT INTO tasks (title, status, created_at) VALUES (?, 'done', ?)"
46:   );
47:   const result = stmt.run(title, now);
48:   return { id: result.lastInsertRowid as number, title, status: 'pending', created_at: now };
49: }

53: }

56:   return db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ?").get(id) as Task | undefined;
57: }

66:   const task = getTask(id);

69:   const params: (string | number)[] = [];
70:   if (fields.title !== undefined) { updates.push("title = ?"); params.push(fields.title); }
71:   if (fields.status !== undefined) { updates.push("status = ?"); params.push(fields.status); }
72:   if (updates.length > 0) {
73:     params.push(id);
74:     db.prepare(`UPDATE tasks SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`).run(...params);
